what: A Chip whose word is shorter than 44 pt fails the targets probe: in English the first kind word 'All' is 35.5 x 44 (marketplace-*.en, every state). Hungarian 'Minden' (56) and German 'Alle' pass. Chip takes no className, so the screen cannot widen it.
how: Give Chip a min-width of the target size (min-w-11, the word left-aligned so the mark still spans the word) - additive, no layout change for any word of 44 pt or more.
interim: None; the en captures report 'probes not passing: targets' for that one chip.
then: Re-run marketplace-1 --lang en; the targets probe passes.
